verdict.rationale: Docs include code snippets (e.g., checkout creation) and a page listing 'methods available to a merchant and checkout', but there is no evidence of a true interactive, runnable API reference (like Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) — in fact the probe found openapi.json/swagger.json endpoints all 404, suggesting no standard interactive spec-based reference exists. Missing for 10: an actual interactive 'try it out' console, live runnable examples in-browser, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
